title: The Stamp on the Back of the Envelope
fact_notes: 登場人物・活動・場所・観察結果は架空の教育事例。特定の実在の調査・製品・制度を報告するものではない。参考リンクは制作台帳であり外部の実証資料ではない。

sentences.en: An elderly resident donated a collection of old envelopes to a town history museum.
sentences.ja: ある高齢の住民が古い封筒の集まりを町の歴史博物館に寄贈した。

sentences.en: The letters that had once been inside them were missing, so the envelopes seemed to contain little useful information.
sentences.ja: 中に入っていた手紙がなくなっていたため、封筒には有用な情報がほとんどないように見えた。

sentences.en: However, a museum volunteer noticed several different stamps and dates printed on their surfaces.
sentences.ja: しかし博物館のボランティアは表面に印された異なるスタンプや日付に気づいた。

sentences.en: She wondered whether these marks could help explain how correspondence had reached the town in the past.
sentences.ja: これらの印から昔の郵便物がどのように町に届いたか分かるのではないかと考えた。

sentences.en: The volunteer arranged the envelopes according to the dates that could still be read clearly.
sentences.ja: ボランティアはまだ明瞭に読める日付に従って封筒を並べた。

sentences.en: She discovered that some had been marked in more than one town before reaching their final destination.
sentences.ja: 最終目的地に届く前に複数の町で印を押されたものがあると分かった。

sentences.en: Others displayed marks that were too faint to identify with confidence.
sentences.ja: ほかには確信を持って特定するには薄すぎる印があった。

sentences.en: Instead of guessing their meaning, she recorded them as uncertain and continued her investigation.
sentences.ja: 意味を推測する代わりに不確かなものとして記録し、調査を続けた。

sentences.en: A local railway enthusiast offered to help her compare the dates with old transport schedules preserved in another collection.
sentences.ja: 地元の鉄道愛好家が別の資料集に保存された古い交通時刻表と日付を比較するのを手伝うと申し出た。

sentences.en: Together, they identified several possible routes that correspondence might have followed between communities.
sentences.ja: 二人は郵便物が地域間を移動した可能性のある経路をいくつか特定した。

sentences.en: The existence of these routes did not prove that every envelope had traveled along them.
sentences.ja: 経路が存在していたことはすべての封筒がそこを通った証明にはならなかった。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, the schedules offered additional context for interpreting the marks on individual envelopes.
sentences.ja: それでも時刻表は個々の封筒の印を解釈するための追加の文脈となった。

sentences.en: The museum prepared an exhibition that included maps, photographs, and enlarged images of the original marks.
sentences.ja: 博物館は地図、写真、元の印の拡大画像を含む展示を用意した。

sentences.en: Each label distinguished information that had been confirmed from interpretations that were still being investigated.
sentences.ja: 各説明札は確認済みの情報と調査中の解釈を区別した。

sentences.en: Visitors were invited to contribute further records if they had relevant materials at home.
sentences.ja: 関連資料を自宅に持っていれば追加の資料を提供するよう来場者に呼びかけた。

sentences.en: One visitor brought a timetable that the museum had not previously examined.
sentences.ja: ある来場者は博物館が以前に調べたことのない時刻表を持参した。

sentences.en: The exhibition demonstrated that historical investigation can begin with objects that contain very little writing.
sentences.ja: 展示は歴史調査が文字のごく少ない物から始まることもあると示した。

sentences.en: Even when some information is missing, the remaining details may provide useful clues.
sentences.ja: 一部の情報が失われていても、残った細部が有用な手がかりになる場合がある。

sentences.en: However, such clues become more meaningful when considered alongside independent sources of evidence.
sentences.ja: しかしそのような手がかりは独立した証拠と併せて考えるとより意味を持つ。

sentences.en: The volunteer had learned to appreciate the questions an incomplete object could inspire.
sentences.ja: ボランティアは不完全な物が生み出す問いを大切にするようになった。

questions.prompt: Why did the envelopes initially seem unhelpful?
options: Their dates had been written recently.
The museum had no interest in history.
questions.explanation_ja: 中身の手紙がなかった。
異なるスタンプと日付。

questions.prompt: How did she organize the envelopes?
options: By the names of all writers.
By the colors of their contents.
questions.explanation_ja: 読める日付順に並べた。

questions.prompt: What did she do about unclear marks?
options: Recorded the uncertainty instead of guessing.
Removed the marks from the envelopes.
Assigned a definite meaning to every mark.
questions.explanation_ja: 不確かなものとして記録した。

questions.prompt: What did the railway enthusiast help compare?
options: The museum's annual accounts and ticket prices.
questions.explanation_ja: 昔の時刻表と日付を比較した。

questions.prompt: What did the existence of the possible routes NOT prove?
options: That some transport schedules were preserved.
That the researchers had considered several possibilities.
That routes between communities had existed.
That each envelope had actually followed those routes.
questions.explanation_ja: 個々の封筒が実際に通った証明ではない。

questions.prompt: How did the museum label the exhibits?
options: It separated confirmed information from ongoing interpretations.
It presented every theory as established fact.
It included only the volunteers' names.
questions.explanation_ja: 確認済みと調査中を区別。

options: A completed biography of every donor.
A timetable not previously examined by the museum.
A model of a railway station.
A missing letter makes historical investigation impossible.
Every postal mark has only one certain meaning.
Incomplete historical objects can offer clues when combined with other evidence.
Modern timetables explain every object from the past.
questions.explanation_ja: 欠けた史料でも他の証拠と組み合わせると役立つ。

grammar.explanation_ja: too ... toは〜するにはあまりに…という意味。

grammar.explanation_ja: when＋過去分詞は受動の意味を持つ省略節。

paraphrases.source: The letters that had once been inside them were missing, so the envelopes seemed to contain little useful information.
paraphrases.rewrite: As the original letters were gone, the envelopes did not appear especially useful at first.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 手紙がなく有用に見えなかった。

paraphrases.source: Others displayed marks that were too faint to identify with confidence.
paraphrases.rewrite: Some markings were so unclear that their meaning could not be established confidently.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 印が薄く特定できなかった。

paraphrases.source: The existence of these routes did not prove that every envelope had traveled along them.
paraphrases.rewrite: Knowing the routes existed was not enough to establish that all the envelopes had used them.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 経路の存在だけでは個別の移動を証明できない。

paraphrases.source: However, such clues become more meaningful when considered alongside independent sources of evidence.
paraphrases.rewrite: Those clues become more valuable if researchers examine them together with separate documentary evidence.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 独立した資料との照合で意味が増す。
